localizedValue.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference: Authentic taste of Hanoi -Tour with a local foodie
We walk through Old Quarter (in a group), discovering lesser-known local dishes owned by local families. Food is included in the price
Ninh Binh Small Group Max 15 Guests by Limousine
Explore Ninh Binh’s highlights in a small group of up to 15 guests. Visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu, enjoy a scenic boat trip in Trang An, and admire the stunning panoramic views from Hang Mua.
Taste Vietnamese street cuisine with a local
Wander Hanoi's Old Quarter, tasting 8- 10 dishes at family restaurants and street stands.
Ninh Binh full day, Trang An, Mua Cave, Limousine
This is Ninh Binh full-day adventure including Dinh & Le temples in Hoa Lu ancient capital, Trang An grottoes, and Múa Cave (Dragon peak), in a group tour (20 people)
Hanoi Cooking Class with Local Market Tour
Join a market tour and cooking class in Hanoi. Enjoy fresh ingredients & traditional food.
Ha Long Bay by luxury boat and limousine bus
Discover the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay on a luxury boat and limousine bus journey, featuring the magnificent Sung Sot Cave and a delicious buffet lunch with a wide variety of dishes.
Under the Surface: Untold War Stories of Hanoi
Trace Vietnam’s wartime scars through hidden streets, relics, and family stories.
Learn how to make  phở and bún chả  with chef
Located in the Old Quarter, this well-organized class, taught by a chef with over 10 years of experience, will give you authentic experiences and equip you with cutting, slicing, and cooking skills.
Hanoi: Traditional Cooking Class & Market Tour
Learn four authentic recipes and make egg coffee.
Hanoi Cooking Class & Coffee Tasting Delights
Join a hands-on Hanoi cooking class with market tour, home-style meal, and free wine. End with a tasting of Vietnam’s salted, egg, or coconut coffee. $1 from each guest supports charity meals.
French Legacy Flavors: Banh Mi & Coffee Workshop
Bake your own baguette, craft authentic banh mi fillings, and brew creamy egg coffee/ salt coffee or coconut coffee while discovering the French legacy behind Hanoi’s iconic flavors.
Savor Hanoi - Old Quarter Culinary Adventure
Savor authentic Vietnamese cuisine and learn local secrets.
Hanoi Coffee Workshop – 6 Icons, 10 Tastings, Wine

Step into Hanoi’s coffee culture! Make 6 different brews, have 9 tastings, and 3 homemade liquors. At every 10AM & 3PM, we offer another session focused 5 brews of Vietnamese Cafe Workshop in 2 hours.
Hanoi Vintage Jeep Tour: Backstreets & Hidden Gems
Discover Hanoi in style aboard a vintage Jeep! Cruise through hidden alleys, bustling local markets, Train Street, and iconic landmarks while experiencing the city’s vibrant culture, local daily life
Hanoi’s Vibrant Beer Hoi Culture with a Beer Lover
If you prefer the Anthony Bourdain style of travel, experiencing local culture, eating good food, drinking at hidden watering holes outside of the touristy Old Quarter then this is the tour for you.
Hanoi Knife Making - The Original Masterclass
Had enough typical tourist activities? Let’s get your hands dirty through the fire & steel to craft your own traditional Vietnamese knife in a historic blacksmith village. Create your lasting legacy!
Coffee, History & Architecture in French Quarter
Discover Hanoi’s French Quarter through coffee, culture, and history. Wander grand boulevards, hidden gems, and learn how the past still breathes today. Highly recommend for your first day in Ha Noi!
Discover Hanoi Food Tour with Train Street Visit
Try favorite local dishes—including Pho (Mixed Phở and Phở Roll), Vietnamese Bánh Mì, and Bún Chả (grilled pork with vermicelli)—on a tasting tour that includes a stroll down the iconic Train Street.
Pub crawl party & Hanoi nightlife at various bars
Discover the local music scene, from traditional folk to modern pop, and visit a beer bar.
4-day Famous Ha Giang Loop by motorbike
Go on a 4 day adventure through valleys and villages, with local culture and cuisine.
Explore Hanoi's vegan street food and history
Explore Hanoi’s vegan street food and uncover hidden history on a walking tour full of flavor, culture, and local insights.
Explore Hanoi’s Incense Village & Train Street
Discover the art of incense making and capture plenty unique photos, then experience the thrill of Hanoi’s Train Street—relax at a cozy café, sip a drink, and watch the train pass just inches away
Hanoi Street Food Tour with a Real Foodie
Sample local dishes, coffee, tea, and beer in a vibrant 3-hour gathering.
N Y N A Coffee - Egg Coffee/Coconut/Salted Coffee

“Join NYNA’s coffee-making class to explore the history and culture of Vietnamese coffee and experience the art of crafting Egg Coffee, Coconut Coffee, and Salted Coffee – signature flavors of Vietnam
Hanoi Train Street Food Tour with Local Guide
Discover the flavors of Hanoi on a street food tour of Train Street with my co-host. Sample traditional Vietnamese dishes, explore hidden gems, and sip a drink as you wait for the train to pass by
Explore Hanoi & train street by motorbike
Discover Hanoi’s hidden stories and local life by motorbike on this thrilling ride
Indulge in a Halong Bay full day cruise
Glide across the bay for a full day of activities and Vietnamese culture.
Eat Like A Local - Hanoi Street Food & Hidden Path
Savor Hanoi’s best local street food while exploring hidden alleys and stories of the Hanoi Old Quarter. A journey of flavors, history, and culture with locals.
Explore Ha Long Bay: 5-Star Friends Cruise & Kayak
Cruise among limestone islands, kayak through quiet caves, hike Titop Island, and share a sunset party on deck with new friends guided by a local team.
Hanoi Street Food Tour – Scooter with Local Guides

Everyone does the same touristy Old Quarter food tour - you go further. Into hidden alleys, authentic eats, local sights across Hanoi only reachable by scooter. This is the real Hanoi street food tour
Hanoi: Taste Vietnamese Egg, Salt & Coconut Coffee
Immerse in Vietnam’s coffee culture with 6 iconic brews, from bean to cup. Enjoy hands-on brewing with free vegan-friendly customization. Choose your preferred workshop language: English or Mandarin.
N Y N A Coffee - Egg Coffee/Coconut/Salted Coffee

“Join NYNA’s coffee-making class to explore the history and culture of Vietnamese coffee and experience the art of crafting Egg Coffee, Coconut Coffee, and Salted Coffee – signature flavors of Vietnam
Enjoy an authentic Hanoian dinner
Experience a cozy homemade Vietnamese dinner with my family. Beyond daily cooked dishes is a cultural experience of what's preserved in each Vietnamese dinner.
Bite into Hanoi : Authentic Street Food Experience
Explore Hanoi’s Old Quarter, taste local street food and discover the stories behind each bite.
Explore Incense Village & Conical Hat Village Tour
Together we will capture incense scenes and try conical hat making in two traditional craft villages.
Cooking class with market tour & Pho from scratch

Cook in a peaceful garden 
Make fresh pho noodles by hand from scratch Visit a local market and learn about Vietnamese ingredients
Cook 4 dishes, Bun Cha, Spring Rolls & Banh Xeo
Ninh Binh Small Group 7–9 Pax Excl Entrance Fees

Explore Hoa Lu, cycle through local villages, enjoy a scenic Trang An or Tam Coc boat ride, and hike 500 steps to Dragon Mountain.This is a small group of max 9 guests by luxury car for a more private
Toitoi - Learn Hanoi's culinary secrets
Learn Hanoi’s culinary traditions with a market tour and cooking class.
The Hidden Hanoi Old Quarter Experience
Explore Hanoi’s Old Quarter beyond the tourist trail. Taste, walk, and listen as hidden gems share their stories.
Hanoi Tea Workshop: Craft 3 Local Tea & 9 Tastings
Discover the heart of Vietnamese beverage culture through hands-on brewing, authentic local stories, and 9 tastings featuring signature teas, local coffees, and traditional fruit liqueurs.
Unravel Vietnamese Specialty Coffee
Navigate the art of Vietnamese coffee brewing and tasting with unique local beans.
Cook Like a Local - Hanoi Cooking Class
Shop, dine, and drink as the locals do as you visit a wet market, make traditional dishes from scratch, sip rice wine, and finish with a famed egg coffee (Vegan/ vegetarian menu are available).
Eating through old quarter with a local foodie
Discover lesser-known dishes and hidden gems in Hanoi’s Old Town (in a group)
Cycle and kayak through Ninh Binh wonders
Pedal through the ancient capital of Hoa Lu, kayak through Tam Coc's three caves, and trek to Mua Cave for panoramic views.
Hanoi: Bike Tour Through Hidden and Banana Island
Discover Hanoi's hidden gems and traditional local cuisine with a resident cyclist.
All-in-One Hanoi Fullday Incense Village City Tour
Spend a day discovering iconic landmarks of Hanoi, immersing yourself in the colorful traditions of the Incense Village, and enjoying authentic Vietnamese cuisine for a memorable cultural experience
Ninh Binh Hoa Lu, Trang An & Mua Cave Tour
Discover Ninh Binh in one day: explore Hoa Lu, cycle through peaceful villages, enjoy a local buffet, cruise Trang An by sampan, hike Mua Cave Peak, then return to Hanoi.
Unique Vietnamese Coffee Class - Afternoon Class
Learn the art of brewing traditional Vietnamese coffee.
Learn watercolor painting in Hanoi
Discover your creativity in a unique workshop, with local artist and weird pets.
Half day: Secret Handicraft Villages of Hanoi

Want to see the real Vietnam in my hometown?
Looking to do something a little different?
Come join me on our “Secret Handicraft Villages of Hanoi” 
Available as a half-day: morning or afternoon.

Uncover Hanoi Mega Grand World

Discover Hanoi Mega Grand World, a vibrant entertainment hub inspired by iconic cultures worldwide. 
Capture stunning photos & enjoy the Grand Voyage Show with lights, fireworks, and 3D mapping
Survival Vietnamese: Speak & Connect Like a Local
Practice essential Vietnamese phrases, pronunciation, and local etiquette in a fun, interactive session. Upgrade your Vietnam experience & connect with locals, feel confident and at home in Vietnam.
Hanoi Knife Making - The Original Masterclass

Enjoy making pottery with a local expert
Watch fellow travelers learn about the history, culture, people immersed in the craft.
Hanoi Body Mist Perfume Making Workshop in Vietnam
Create your own custom body mist perfume in Hanoi. Learn the basics of fragrance blending, choose between 50ml bottles, and take home a personalized perfume souvenir.
Create handmade silver jewelry in Hanoi
Learn ancient Vietnamese silversmithing in a historic craft village
Artistic & Nontouristy tour tailored by a local
Nontouristy areas. Magical encounters with your next favorite artists. 100% private tour. The price is charged per person!
Hanoi Cultural Photowalk
If you love the vibrant of Hanoi's street life but don't know how or where is the best to capture it. This photowalk is for you.
Make Bat Trang Pottery in Hanoi's Old Quarter
Learn pottery-wheel basics, practice with unlimited clay, and make your own Bát Tràng creations with guidance. One piece is included for firing and glazing; additional pieces cost extra.
Enjoy Hanoi with a street photographer
Join a pro in his journey to shoot Hanoi street life, phone or camera welcome.
Hanoi: Vietnam Gemstone Silver Clay Ring Workshop
Create your own handmade ring in a fun and beginner-friendly workshop in Hanoi. Using silver clay, you’ll shape, fire, and polish a unique accessory to take home as a one-of-a-kind keepsake.
Learn How To Shoot Film With A Hanoi Photographer
Capture Hanoi on film with a pro camera & film roll included. Guided by the founder of I.am.Long Photography, we meet at a café, learn your camera, then explore the city.
Natural Incense Workshop
Experience making your own incense with plenty types of Vietnamese herbs
